title: Dynacraft Recalls Urban Shredder Ride-On Toys Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The Urban Shredder ride-on toys can unexpectedly accelerate and cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 8,900.

title: Haier America Expands Recall of Chest Freezers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: A capacitor in the freezer's circuitry can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 41,000, 67,500 additional freezers were recalled in November 2010.

title: Remote-Controlled Helicopters Recalled by Midwest Trading Group Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable battery inside the helicopters can overheat and ignite the helicopter, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers or nearby items. Units: 9400.

title: Classic Characters Recalls Infant Socks Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store
summary: The stitched knit frog face and feet on the socks can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants and young children. Units: About 5,000 pairs.

title: Infant and Children’s Dungarees Recalled by J.P. Boden Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The studs and clasps on the pants can detach, posing a choking hazard to infants and small children. Units: About 1,900.

title: Trident Diving Equipment Recalls High-Pressure Scuba Diving Air Hoses Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The diving hose that connects the regulator to the tank's pressure gauge can leak, posing a drowning hazard to the user. Units: About 200.

title: Gerbings Recalls Heated Jacket Liners Due to Burn Hazard
summary: A defective wire connector can cause the jacket liner to overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 9,900.

title: Huffy Recalls Slider Tricycles Due to Loss of Control Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys R Us
summary: The handlebar can unexpectedly loosen while in use, causing the rider to lose control. This poses crash and fall hazards for the rider. Units: About 5,040.

title: Small World Toys Recalls Spin-A-Mals Farm and Safari Puzzles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: Small pegs on the puzzle boards can loosen and separate from the boards, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 4,000.

title: Overstock.com Recalls High-Powered Magnet Sets Due to Ingestion Hazards
summary: When two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: 539.

title: Toys R Us Recalls High-Powered Magnet Sets Due to Ingestion Hazards
summary: When two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About 60.

title: Six Retailers Announce Recall of Buckyballs and Buckycubes High-Powered Magnet Sets Due to Ingestion Hazard
summary: These products contain defects in the design, warnings and instructions, which pose a substantial risk of injury and death to children and teenagers. Units: About three million sets.

title: Carter’s Recalls Infant Clothing with Zippers Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The zipper pull can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 218,000.

title: Baby Socks Recalled by Trumpette Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The flowers and the bows on the baby socks can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 33,000 pairs.

title: Battenfeld Technologies Recalls Three-Digit Combination Locking Handgun Vaults Due to Lock Malfunction
summary: The lock can fail and allow unintended access to the contents of the vault. Units: About 3,900 in the U.S. and about 100 in Canada.

title: Home Depot Recalls CE Tech Riser Cable Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The riser cable does not meet fire resistance standards for riser cable, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,300.

title: Manchester Tank & Equipment Company Recalls Propane Cylinders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Fuel can leak from the thread connection between the cylinder and valve, posing a fire hazard if exposed to an ignition source. Units: About 7,500.

title: MTD Products Recalls Cub Cadet Commercial Lawn Mowers Due to Risk of Fire (Recall Alert)
summary: Fuel can leak from the vent valve grommet on top of the fuel tank during operation, posing a risk of fire. Units: About 2,100.

title: 3T Design Recalls Cervélo Bicycles with Aura Pro Handlebars Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The bicycle's handlebar clamps can detach during riding causing the rider to lose control, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 623 in the United States and 53 in Canada.

title: Currey & Company Recalls Chandeliers Due to Electric Shock Hazard
summary: Defective wiring can conduct electricity to the chandeliers' metal parts, posing an electric shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,100 in the United States and 100 in Canada.

title: The Land of Nod Recallsa Plush Dollies Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The hands on the plush dolls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,500.

title: Children’s Apparel Network Recalls Girl’s Clothing Sets; Waist Belt Poses Risk of Entrapment
summary: The vest sold with these sets has a faux half-belt sewn into the side seams with a hook and eye closure at the waist that could become snagged or caught in small spaces or vehicle doors and it poses an entanglement hazard. Units: About 9,200.

title: Reed and Barton Recalls Gingham Bunny Forks and Spoons for Babies Due to Choking and Ingestion Hazards
summary: The pink coloring on the bunny's ears can come off, posing choking and ingestion hazards to babies. Units: About 4,000.

title: Target Recalls Giada De Laurentiis Lasagna Pan Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The pan can break causing sharp edges and posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 148,700.

title: West Elm Recalls Floor Lamps Due to Injury and Shock Hazards
summary: A failure of the lamp's joint locking mechanisms can cause the lamp to collapse and the electrical cord to spark, posing injury and shock hazards to consumers. Units: About 900.
